title: Add the Oracle Cloud provider with evidence-pinned profiles (last of six F008 providers)
objective: Add Oracle Cloud to the ingest layer with evidence-pinned extraction profiles, to the standard set by the merged AWS slice (PR #70). Oracle markets an 'Always Free' tier more prominently than any other provider in this set, so this is the slice most able to produce the one failure this product cannot absorb: an unsupported claim that a service is free. Every offer type, every material condition and every coverage state must follow from blocks quoted verbatim from a committed capture of an official Oracle document, never from marketing language and never from an author's summary. A wrongly-omitted free offer is also a defect, so where Oracle genuinely does satisfy a condition that must be evidenced too.
measured_premise: P1 MEASURED: base re-derived with `git ls-remote origin main` = 3b382aa4f95a6abb02e6739637449302313dd618, which equals this worktree's HEAD. The brief's stated dispatch SHA was not trusted; it was independently confirmed.

P2 MEASURED (live, HTTP 200, repository's own LiveFetcher + _DocumentCollector): unlike AWS's documentation host, every Oracle page probed is SERVER-RENDERED and parses to real content. www.oracle.com/cloud/free/ 74701 B, 0 tables, 92 blocks. www.oracle.com/cloud/free/faq/ 55679 B, 0 tables, 104 blocks. docs.oracle.com .../FreeTier/freetier.htm 11116 B, 0 tables, 32 blocks. docs.oracle.com .../FreeTier/freetier_topic-Always_Free_Resources.htm 53761 B, 1 table, 184 blocks. docs.oracle.com .../GSG/Tasks/signingup_topic-What_Happens_When_the_Promotion_Expires.htm 7322 B, 0 tables, 16 blocks. www.oracle.com/mysql/free/ 42716 B, 0 tables, 87 blocks.

P3 MEASURED: exactly ONE probed Oracle page publishes a free-tier fact in a table the engine can select - the Always Free Resources doc, whose single <table> has the live header row ['Resource', 'Limit Name', 'Always Free'] and 6 body rows. Every other probed page is either table-free or its tables fail header-row selection. www.oracle.com/cloud/price-list/ served 120 tables and exactly 1 is header-selectable, and that one is a PAID comparison table ('Service' / 'Comparison price (/vCPU)*' / 'Unit price' / 'Unit'). www.oracle.com/database/nosql/pricing/ served 23 tables, 1 header-selectable, also a paid price table, and its served HTML contains no free-tier prose at all.

P4 MEASURED: www.oracle.com/cloud/compute/pricing/ and www.oracle.com/cloud/networking/load-balancing/pricing/ both REDIRECT to www.oracle.com/cloud/price-list/, so they are one document and not two. www.oracle.com/cloud/storage/object-storage/pricing/ redirects to a client-rendered cost estimator whose served HTML carries no storage allowance. docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/FreeTier/freetier_topic-Overview_of_Free_Tier.htm and www.oracle.com/autonomous-database/free/ both return HTTP 404. None of these is used, and none is worked around.

P5 MEASURED, and it is the decisive fact of the slice: Oracle states a payment card requirement in blocks of its own, on FOUR independent documents. docs .../FreeTier/freetier.htm: 'For security purposes, most users need a mobile phone number and a credit card to create an account. Your credit card will not be charged unless you upgrade your account.' www.oracle.com/cloud/free/faq/, www.oracle.com/cloud/free/ and www.oracle.com/mysql/free/ each carry: 'To provide free Oracle Cloud accounts to our valued customers, we need to ensure that you are who you say you are. We use your contact information and credit/debit card information for account setup and identity verification. ...' docs .../GSG/Tasks/signingup_topic-Sign_Up_for_Free_Oracle_Cloud_Promotion.htm states it as an imperative procedure step: 'Select Add payment verification method, and then select Credit Card.' NO Oracle document probed states that a card is NOT required.

P6 MEASURED, and it is the reason this slice exists: Oracle's Always Free tier IS genuinely perpetual, by quotation. docs .../FreeTier/freetier_topic-Always_Free_Resources.htm: 'All Oracle Cloud Infrastructure accounts (whether free or paid) have a set of resources that are free of charge in the home region of the tenancy, for the life of the account.' www.oracle.com/cloud/free/faq/: 'Always Free services are part of Oracle Cloud Free Tier. Always Free services are available for an unlimited time. ...' Both satisfy rule 1 of docs/DATA_MODEL.md by quotation, so `always_free` here is not inferred from the word 'free'. Perpetual is STILL not Z0, and Oracle is the third provider to prove it - after AWS Step Functions and Azure Cosmos DB.

P7 MEASURED trap avoided: the block 'You will only be charged for services that you use that exceeds Always Free.' looks like an automatic-billing statement for the Always Free offer. It is NOT. Its FAQ question, carried in a <div class="cb105w3"> that the collector does not capture, is 'How do I know how much I am going be charged for Pay As You Go services?'. The block's own context is a PAID account, so pinning it as the Always Free offer's exhaustion behaviour would be composition. It is not pinned as an exhaustion behaviour anywhere in this slice.

P8 MEASURED: the Always Free Resources document states an exhaustion consequence for exactly one Always Free quota in a block of its own - the five-volume-backup limit, where 'if you try to create new backups, the operation will fail with an error until you delete existing Always Free volume backups'. That is `request_rejected`, a SAFE stop. It is recorded as that offer's exhaustion behaviour and is NOT generalised into a claim about every Always Free quota.

P9 The engine's Z0 path (apps/api/app/classify/engine.py, read not assumed) requires offer_type outside TEMPORARY_CONDITIONAL_OFFER_TYPES, requires_card is False, has_paid_dependencies is False, and a non-empty set of exhaustion behaviours all drawn from SAFE_EXHAUSTION. Gate 3 (Z1) fires on requires_card is True before gate 4 (UNKNOWN) and gate 5 (Z2), so a quoted card requirement produces Z1_BILLING_EXPOSURE.

acceptance_criteria: AC1 Six official Oracle sources over six DISTINCT documents load through the real config loader, all trust_level official, all on www.oracle.com or docs.oracle.com.

AC2 Every committed capture is GENERATED from the live document's own parse. The generator resolves each pinned block by a short unique needle against the live blocks and REFUSES TO WRITE on zero matches or more than one match, and refuses when the parsed target-table rows differ from live. No quotation is transcribed by hand.

AC3 Both reconciliation directions are reported with counts. LIVE -> FIXTURE is primary: every pinned block occurs exactly once live and exactly once in the capture, and every live target-table row is present. FIXTURE -> LIVE is supporting only and never carries a pass alone.
AC4 Driving the real HtmlDocAdapter over the LIVE bytes and over the committed fixture produces identical fact sets for all six sources.

AC5 A mutation battery with predictions recorded in the parametrisation BEFORE the run: a deleted, reworded or truncated pinned block yields assertion_not_found; a duplicated block yields ambiguous_assertion; an undeclared matrix row yields unknown_matrix_rows; a removed mapped row yields missing_matrix_rows; a renamed tier header yields table_not_found; a duplicated table yields ambiguous_table. FALSE-POSITIVE CONTROLS prove the guards discriminate rather than reject any edit: an unrelated extra column and whitespace/entity noise must NOT produce an error, and an unrelated added paragraph must leave the verdict intact.

AC6 At least two guards are mutation-tested by making the error UNPRODUCIBLE - patch the guard, print the patched line, show the target error dies on an input that should raise it - each with a collateral control proving a healthy document still extracts.
AC7 Every Oracle offer's classifier verdict is computed by the REAL engine and recorded. No offer reaches Z0_TRUE_FREE.

AC8 A POSITIVE CONTROL proves the classifier can emit Z0_TRUE_FREE, and a further test proves that control is LOAD-BEARING: with the thing it guards broken, the control FAILS while the no-Z0 sweep still passes. A control that cannot fail proves nothing.

AC9 The blocking condition for every non-Z0 verdict is reported by SHAPE, distinguishing a gate that fails on a QUOTED sentence from a gate that fails on ABSENCE of any statement. Absence-based gates are named explicitly.

AC10 All fourteen canonical coverage categories are declared. No category is verified_free. No category is not_offered without evidence. Every unknown names what was actually probed, or says plainly that it was not probed.

AC11 Captures declare their structure honestly: live table count, whether a table was retained, non-target tables removed, target rows/cells removed (both empty for the matrix), unpivoted columns, duplicated live blocks retained and not retained, and the sha256 of every pinned block.

AC12 Full suite passes against a REAL PostgreSQL on a dedicated scratch database, and the integration tests RUN rather than skip. scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit passes except the pre-existing accepted apps/web advisory, if it is still failing on untouched main.
AC13 Protected state verified by `git hash-object` blob comparison against base, never by `git diff --numstat`.

negative_and_regression_tests: Five synthetic document cases: unchanged (positive control), changed, partial, malformed, contradictory - each declaring synthetic:true and a named mutation.
Mutation battery with false-positive controls, including an unrelated added paragraph that must leave the verdict intact.
Deleting the card sentence must REJECT the document rather than yield a cardless offer.
Deleting the perpetuity sentence must REJECT rather than leave a stale offer type.
Duplicate-block probe proving that declining to pin a block Oracle publishes twice was necessary rather than stylistic.

level_2_remediation.F1: SHIPPED FALSE CLAIM, corrected. oracle.py and docs/PROVIDER_ADAPTERS.md asserted as a general law that perpetual offers are never free. MEASURED across all 7 provider configurations: of 14 perpetual offers, 5 are Z0_TRUE_FREE (GitHub x3, Cloudflare x2), 5 are Z1, 4 are UNKNOWN. Restricted to the six F008 providers the Z0 count is 3, all GitHub; Cloudflare is F005. The claim was wrong in BOTH directions at once - omission-favouring in its conclusion, and under-counting its own support by omitting GCP. Replaced with an entailment statement plus the one distinctive claim that survives re-derivation: Oracle is the only provider whose perpetual offer is withheld by a quoted payment-card requirement rather than by automatic billing.
level_2_remediation.F2: Capture reconciliation counted retained blocks and called them pinned, overstating five of six sources by one (the document <title>). Recomputed from each profile's own assertions: 24, 6, 7, 6, 5, 7. Retained-but-not-pinned blocks are now declared separately, and five dead *_TITLE constants that no profile asserted were removed from the module and its __all__.
level_2_remediation.F3: This contract's own test and baseline figures were stale after the rebase; re-derived above.
level_2_remediation.F4: The containers-app-hosting rationale said 'APEX Application Development' appears on BOTH documents - literally true as a substring, but the OCI occurrence is an Autonomous AI Database WORKLOAD TYPE, not an Always Free service entry. Corrected to state that both list entries appear on the FAQ only.
